g.text: FrontEnd 2/3 — Scene Blocks, Input & Machine Data (Unity)
Bridge interfaces appear as stubs here — the full ISubject/IObserver
hierarchy is in FRONTEND_VIEW.puml. Panels: FRONTEND_PANEL.puml
ExecuteCommand() is the common machine-action path: checks
command.CanExecute, pays command.GetPrice via PayMoney, then
level are read off Machine directly (via IMachineSubject) by the
panel, so BeltBlock no longer mirrors them.
